resources.string: These choices personalize the checklist. They do not change connections or enable or disable therapy commands.
Blood measurements and context notes can be saved without a sensor. A single measurement is not continuous monitoring; it does not provide continuous alerts or a reliable forecast.
Choose an existing data source in settings. A selected sensor is not a connection: check that a recent glucose reading actually appears on Overview.
AAPS supplies treatment history. Sending meals, Eating Soon and targets requires a separate command permission; setup does not grant it.
Blood measurements, meals, injections and notes can be saved locally without AAPS. Diary records do not calculate IOB/COB or authorize treatment. Missing IOB and COB must not be treated as zero.
Optional. Enter known date of birth, height and weight for energy estimates. Do not guess missing values; the diary remains available.

Check channels, sound and background restrictions separately. Permission alone does not confirm sound delivery. Continuous glucose alerts require fresh data and an active analysis pipeline; manual measurements do not replace monitoring. No test sound is played here.
You can finish with optional steps pending. Check the actual data on Overview. Reopen this checklist in Settings at any time; finishing does not certify connections, forecasts or alerts.
Therapy commands were already enabled. Equipment choices do not turn them off.
Therapy commands are blocked. Data entry does not require enabling them.
Settings could not be loaded or saved. Progress is not confirmed.
